title: Alien Sniper Watch
description: Scan bustling city scenes with your visor, spot disguised extraterrestrials hiding in plain sight, and line up clean sniper shots without hitting civilians.
controls: Toggle scanner vision to expose hidden aliens, drag to aim your sniper scope, and release to fire.

zh-CN.title: 狙击外星人
zh-CN.description: 爆款都市识破伪装狙击：开启扫描仪揪出混在人群里的外星卧底，稳准开镜一枪命中，千万别误伤路人。
zh-CN.controls: 切换扫描视角识别伪装外星人，按住拖动瞄准镜锁定目标后松手开火。
